purpose: Teach: 声援/町民/趙/マメ/穂/山々/見所/７つ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご家族のスポーツチームに声援を送ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer—they're always cheering on their family's sports team.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Soft voice. Slight pause between clauses, like she's thinking fondly about something she noticed. A smile beneath the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、町民会館の活動に参加されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer volunteers with the activities at the town hall, doesn't he?
lines.style: Curious, continuing the thought naturally. Light rise at the end—an observation phrased as a shared discovery. Steady, thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、台湾の趙さんとビジネスをされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he's got business dealings with someone named Zhao from Taiwan.
lines.style: Admiring tone. Slight emphasis on 「Zhao」—registering the detail without dwelling on it. Ongoing thread of appreciation for this person's life.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マメな性格で何でも記録されてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's so meticulous about things—he keeps records of everything.
lines.style: Affectionate noticing. Warm, slightly amused at the precision. Pace steady and unhurried, like cataloguing something she genuinely likes about him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店の前の稲穂のドライフラワーをお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He even complimented the dried rice-ear flowers in front of the shop.
lines.style: Soft smile in the voice. Tender attention to a small detail he noticed. Trailing off slightly—the kind of thing that stays with you.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、山々の写真集を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He showed me this beautiful photo collection he has—all mountain landscapes.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, opening up slightly. Light enthusiasm tempered with gentleness. The remembered pleasure of seeing something meaningful to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、当店の見所はラテアートだって仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He told me the real highlight of this shop is the latte art.
lines.style: Soft laugh underneath. Pride without pretension. Warmth at being seen and appreciated by someone whose eye he trusts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の誕生日に７つの贈り物を準備されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: For his grandson's birthday, he prepared seven gifts—can you imagine?
lines.style: Admiring wonder, quiet delight. Slight emphasis on 「seven」. Closing with genuine awe at the tenderness and care. Reflective, almost awed.
